punchline: In Lencioni's pyramid the base of a team is not strategy but the willingness to admit mistakes in front of each other.
thirty_sec: Lencioni told his team theory as a fable: Kathryn Petersen takes over DecisionTech. His five dysfunctions form a pyramid with trust at the bottom, meaning people willing to be vulnerable with each other. Above it come fear of conflict, weak commitment, avoided accountability and ignored results. His point is that the base cracks first.
